summary: Stale revision: origin/master f2c0e7b42a511dd7f3806c82f0ecfdb5d2497005 is not an ancestor of f1256ae04bceb256bfe2bc64f51cde66bf59dbe4 (merge base ca9e23795abebbe11ec519332a79b9c1d96d9ae2), so it cannot fast-forward master and omits the current master fix scoping critic/tester sweeps to Canopy.
